description: Mathieu Lepot and colleagues at INSA Lyon publish the Urban Drainage Metrology Toolbox, UDMT 2025 a. Its five implemented blocks cover sensor calibration/correlation, correction of raw values with uncertainty, typeA/typeB/Monte Carlo uncertainty assessment, automated validation tests and discharge estimation from tracer experiments. The source provides a Matlab Design App source archive, Windows executable, examples and manual through Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. A webapp is also named, but its running state was not tested. Coverage is general urban-drainage measurement practice, not one geographical case. Related calibration datasets remain separate experimental resources; the deprecated manual and publication describe the same toolbox. A limitation is that the software was not installed, its numerical routines were not verified and public source availability does not establish compatibility with every Matlab/runtime version.
